objective: Prove the OVERLAY works against the REAL server end to end — the one thing the product has never demonstrated. web/test/realServer.e2e.test.tsx already does this for the web app: it boots the real `python3 -m server` on an ephemeral port and drives real /build and /diff calls. The overlay — the actual in-game surface a player uses — has no equivalent, so every overlay test to date mocks the server and nothing proves a copied item produces a real verdict. Add overlay/test/realServer.e2e.test.ts that boots the same real server the same way (copy the spawn/readiness/teardown approach from the web test; do NOT refactor or import it, duplication across package boundaries is correct here) and drives the overlay's OWN path: import the golden PoB code via POST /build, then feed the golden item text through the real createClipboardPipeline composition with bindGeneratedDiff(baseUrl) pointed at that live server, and assert the pipeline emits a schema-valid VerdictCard whose content came from the real engine — not a fixture. Use the same golden inputs the web test pins: engine/corpus/seed/ninja/12-elementalist-ci-cold-snap.json's pathOfBuildingExport and engine/tests/fixtures/item.txt. Follow the web test's availability policy exactly: a missing python3/pyyaml or engine runtime must skip LOUDLY with a clear banner, never silently. If this test finds a real defect in the overlay's live path, STOP and report it in your completion summary rather than changing overlay/src to make the test pass — a red result here is a valuable finding, not a failure to fix.

acceptance_criteria.text: overlay/test/realServer.e2e.test.ts boots the real server via `python3 -m server` on an ephemeral port and tears it down reliably, mirroring web/test/realServer.e2e.test.tsx.

The test drives the overlay's real path — createClipboardPipeline composed with bindGeneratedDiff(baseUrl) — against that live server. No stubbed fetch, no fixture verdict, no hand-rolled request body.
It asserts a schema-valid VerdictCard produced by the real engine from the golden PoB code + golden item text, and that the same input is deterministic across two calls.
A missing python3/pyyaml or engine runtime skips the suite LOUDLY with a clear banner — never a silent skip.
Diff touches only overlay/test/realServer.e2e.test.ts; overlay/src is unmodified. The full overlay suite passes (or the new suite skips loudly per AC-4).
